incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: KV cache paging spike in us-west-2. Paging ops > 600/s, cache eviction rate x8, 95p tail latency > 12s. Related recent flag: batching-v2-enabled rolled 2026-03-14T04:22Z. Metrics: https://ops.redwood/alerts/2368001234

Anna (oncall): ack. Paging + customer timeouts. I'm on it. Who's owning runtime changes?

Elaine (CS): FYI CS ticket 12478 from Acme Inc — they see generation timeouts and webhook retries. Impacting prod for them. They just posted stack traces.

Miguel (SRE): digging into KV dashboards. Evictions concentrated on shard-7, hot-key amplification from a few long-stream requests. Continuous batching appears to batch very large prefixes => cache churn. Suggest immediate mitigation: disable continuous_batching or reduce batch max_tokens.

Tom (eng-runtime): confirmed. The batching-v2 heuristic started grouping streaming requests aggressively when seq_len > 1024. That increases KV insert churn and evicts important prefixes. Quick mitigation options: 1) global rollback of batching-v2-enabled; 2) per-tenant override for heavy tenants (safer); 3) set max_batch_tokens=4096 and limit continuous_batching for tenants > 10RPS.

Jordan (infra): We have a per-tenant flag pipeline with low-latency propagation. We can push a tenant override for Acme instantly. Global rollback requires canary and approvals, but we can do a 5% canary rollback quickly if needed.

Anna (oncall): Plan: do per-tenant override for acme-inc now, start a 5% canary rollback for everyone, watch eviction and tail latency for 15m. If stable, escalate to 100% rollback. Who will execute?

Tom (eng-runtime): I'll run the flags. Commands:
```
# per-tenant override (immediate)
/featureflag set batching-v2-enabled false --tenant=acme-inc --actor=tom --reason="paging mitigation"
# 5% canary rollback
/featureflag set batching-v2-enabled false --percent=5 --actor=tom --reason="canary paging mitigation"
```

Miguel (SRE): also recommended quick kernel-level limit: reduce max_batch_tokens to 4096 for canary group. Add this so micro-batches don't blow up.

Tom (eng-runtime): applying overrides now. Pushing per-tenant override for acme-inc... done. deploy-bot:flag-change confirmed (change_id=ff-3421).

deploy-bot: Feature flag change applied: ff-3421 -> batching-v2-enabled=false for tenant=acme-inc (propagated to us-west-2 runtime pool).

Anna (oncall): seeing initial telemetry?

Miguel (SRE): early signs look good for acme-inc: eviction rate for their shard dropped ~70% in last 60s. Tail latency for their requests down from ~11s to ~1.2s.

Elaine (CS): Just told Acme support contact: "We've applied a targeted mitigation and are monitoring; we'll follow up with root cause and timeline." They asked for ETA on full rollback.

Tom (eng-runtime): kicking canary at 5% now and applying max_batch_tokens=4096 to that cohort. deploy-bot: canary start -> canary-id=cny-778.

deploy-bot: Canary started: cny-778, target=5%, config_changes=[batching-v2-enabled:false, max_batch_tokens:4096].

Miguel (SRE): watching global metrics: overall eviction rate trending down but still noisy. We'll wait 10m after canary warms. If no regressions, promote.

Anna (oncall): noted. I'll keep customers updated. Sam (product), do we want a public status update?

Sam (product): Yes, put a short status note on status.redwood.com: "Degraded performance for text generation in us-west-2. Targeted mitigation applied for affected customers; canary rollback in progress." I'll draft.

Tom (eng-runtime): canary looks stable at +12m: eviction delta -55% across canary hosts, 95p latency down by ~80%. No new OOMs. Recommend promote to 50% then 100% in 5-10m windows.

Miguel (SRE): agree. Promote slowly. Also add a temporary per-tenant cap rule: if tenant_token_rate > 1000 and seq_len > 2048 then force batching-v2=false. This prevents future hot tenants causing churn while we fix heuristics.

Jordan (infra): I can add that rule to the runtime policy engine. Will push a safe rule:
```
runtime-policy set "heavy-tenant-batching-safeguard" \
  --if "tenant_rps>1000 && avg_seq_len>2048" \
  --action "force-flag batching-v2-enabled=false" --scope=us-west-2
```

Anna (oncall): Jordan, please push. Tom, coordinate rollback promotion. Miguel, verify KV eviction and paging metrics. Elaine, prep ACME follow-up. Sam, publish status. I'll be on callwatch until incident is resolved.

Jordan (infra): safeguard rule applied (policy-id=pol-991).

Tom (eng-runtime): promoted canary to 50% -> deploy-bot: promotion ok. Waiting 8m to observe.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: cny-778 -> 50% (ok).

Miguel (SRE): metrics steady. Eviction rate, tail latency improving cluster-wide. No sign of new hot shards. Paging ops down from 620/s to ~140/s in us-west-2.

Tom (eng-runtime): promoted to 100%. deploy-bot: promotion ok, full rollback enacted (batching-v2-enabled=false globally), max_batch_tokens=4096 applied cluster-wide.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion: cny-778 -> 100% (ok). All hosts now running rollback config. Change-id=ff-3421 promoted.

Anna (oncall): observing post-change for 30m. So far: paging normalized, error rates back to baseline, Acme confirmed improved. Great work.

Sam (product): Status page updated. Notifying enterprise customers via outbound note.

Elaine (CS): Acme sent a "thanks". I'll keep the ticket open until postmortem and permanent fix timeline.

Miguel (SRE): next steps: 1) rollback confirmed, 2) create incident ticket and RCA board: category=KV-cache-batching-heuristic; 3) triage for a proper fix: change batching heuristic to consider prefix volatility and sequence-length-weighted batching; 4) add monitoring alert for batch_size_growth_rate to catch regressions earlier.

Tom (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR for heuristic fix and add unit tests that simulate long-stream patterns. Also we should add a canary test in CI that runs traffic profiles.

Anna (oncall): will close incident once follow-ups are tracked and postmortem scheduled. For now: incident status -> mitigated. Thanks everyone. :tada:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigated at 2026-03-14T06:15Z. Follow-up tasks: rca-ticket=INC-2368, action=runtime-heuristic-fix, owner=Tom, due=2026-03-21.

Tom (eng-runtime): filing PR and INC-2368 now.

Miguel (SRE): adding alert: "batch_size_growth_rate > 3x in 5m" -> paging-signal runbook link.

Anna (oncall): handing off to oncall@team for postmortem. I'll paste a short runbook excerpt and timeline in INC-2368. Good job team.

Elaine (CS): will close the customer loop once RCA ready.

Sam (product): recommend we review rolling flag rollout cadence for feature flags that affect cache/meta behavior.

Tom (eng-runtime): +1. We'll change default canary to 10% for batching-related flags and add synthetic load test.

deploy-bot: Note: no CI failures detected for flag change; change metadata attached to INC-2368.

Anna (oncall): incident thread archived when postmortem scheduled.
